summary: Studio City Company Limited announced results of a conditional cash tender offer for any and all of its outstanding $196.4M aggregate principal 7.00% senior secured notes due 2027. Consideration is $1,001.25 per $1,000 principal, representing a 0.125% premium. $196.4M of notes validly tendered by the May 12 expiration, plus $1.5M via guaranteed delivery; settlement expected May 15. The offer is subject to a financing condition. Deutsche Bank Singapore acted as dealer manager; Kroll served as tender agent. The offer reduces leverage and upcoming interest costs. Risk-arb watch: monitor satisfaction of financing condition and any proration or extension.
